Name: TF2NR.GraphicsToggles
Description: AI Enhancements: adds one 'AI Enhancements' row to Settings > Video (the vanilla rows stay in their places). It opens a page with Upscaler (Off / NVIDIA DLSS), Quality (DLAA, Quality, Balanced, Performance, Ultra Performance), DLSS 5 Neural Rendering, DLSS 5 Adjustments (a submenu of Neural Rendering sliders) and AMD FSR 3 Frame Generation (hybrid-graphics laptops only). The values live in tf2nr_* convars that the tf2-dlss-sr, tf2-nr-bridge and tf2-fg ReShade add-ons read every frame. Settings > Mod Settings has a shortcut to the page, the DLSS 5 and Frame Generation switches and the DLSS 5 adjustments.

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_dlss5_nr
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering (renodx-dlss5 or, on Linux/Proton, tf2-nr-linux, driven by tf2-dlss-sr): 0 off (default), 1 on. DLSS upscaler only; with renodx-dlss5 installed, on with tf2nr_dlss_sr 0 runs DLSS at DLAA.

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_dlss_sr
ConVars.HelpString: Upscaling quality via tf2-dlss-sr: 0 off, 1 Native AA (DLAA), 2 Quality (1.5x), 3 Balanced (1.724x), 4 Performance (2.0x), 5 Ultra Performance (3.0x). The backend is tf2nr_upscaler.

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_upscaler
ConVars.HelpString: Upscaler backend for tf2nr_dlss_sr: 1 = NVIDIA DLSS (default; any other value = DLSS). 2 = AMD FSR 3 is reserved: the tf2-dlss-sr in this release has no FSR 3 upscaler and always uses DLSS.

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_upscale_last
ConVars.HelpString: Menu state: the last non-zero tf2nr_dlss_sr, restored when the AI Enhancements Upscaler row goes from Off back to DLSS (set tf2nr_dlss_sr / tf2nr_upscaler on that page, not by hand, to keep it in step)

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_fsr_fg
ConVars.HelpString: AMD FSR 3 frame generation via tf2-fg: 0 off, 1 on. Needs the DLSS upscaler on (tf2nr_dlss_sr 1-5), V-Sync off and [TF2FG] Enable=1. Runs only when the screen is driven by another GPU than the renderer (hybrid laptops); off on desktops, with the screen on the rendering GPU, and while Steam/Discord/RTSS/OBS overlay hooks are loaded. Pauses outside 40 to min(83, refresh/2) real fps ([TF2FG] MinBaseFps/MaxBaseFps).

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_menu_tuning
ConVars.HelpString: 1 = the DLSS 5 Adjustments below drive renodx [RenoDX.DLSS5]; 0 = leave the ReShade.ini / overlay values alone

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_skin
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 NR character/skin structure -> NRSkinStructure (-1..1; renodx v7 clamps to 1; the menu offers 0..1)

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_style
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 NR style -> NRStyle: 0 Default, 1 Natural, 2 Cinematic

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_look_colour
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 Look: colour change kept, 0..2 (NRLookColour; 0 = game's colours)

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_look_hue
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 Look: model tint kept, 0..2 (NRLookHue; 0 = game's hues)

ConVars.Name: tf2nr_nr_stabilize
ConVars.HelpString: DLSS 5 Look stabilize -> NRLookStabilize: 0 Off, 1 Static, 2 Motion
